slug: 2025-10-08 Digital Africa post the pandemic Ghana report

facts.fact: Research ICT Africa's Ghana report, on 2022 survey data, recommends finalising the Digital Economy Policy to give a coherent framework for Ghana's digital transformation, so the policy was not yet final; the report gives no event date and is dated by its publication, 2025-10-08.
